newsitem.title: MEXICO: Abaco raises Mexico's Sigma EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Abaco raises Mexico's Sigma EPS estimate.

text.p: Brokerage Abaco-Rodman said Tuesday it raised its 1996 earnings per share estimate for processed foods company Sigma Alimentos SA.
Abaco-Rodman estimated Sigma's EPS to come in at 4.856 pesos from an earlier prediction of 4.728 pesos.

"On a year-on-year basis we estimate a 12 and 50 percent increase in cold cut and yogurt sales volume, respectively. We believe that this seasonality will change Sigma's operating margin to approximately 7.2 percent," it said.
"Sigma's total debt will decline by approximately nine percent as compared to the third quarter of 1996," it added.
